sample_review.detail: junk rate 5.3%, systematic junk: no, 16 examples, model claude-sonnet-5-5; notes: Mostly clean consumer goods with sensible names, sizes and flags. Only a few isolated junk rows (auto parts in Baby/Toys, keyword-stuffed marketplace names, wholesale or commercial lots, implausible prices), with no single class large enough to call systematic. The clearest pattern is category mislabeling: Christmas greeting cards under School/Office, koozies and magnets under Sports & Outdoors.
